Author: Bao Yonggang  Editor: Lin Juemin  
Physical AI, which refers to intelligent agents that interact with the real world, is becoming one of the most talked-about topics in the tech community. The appearance of various forms of robots at CES 2026 is exploring the boundaries and possibilities of Physical AI. During CES 2026, Professor Amnon Shashua, founder, president, and CEO of Mobileye, stated in a conversation with Leiphone: "Cars and robots are currently the two most typical application scenarios for Physical AI." In both directions, Mobileye is not a bystander.  
Automotive is Mobileye's long-established and well-known foundation, while robotics represents its newly showcased growth engine. After announcing the acquisition of the humanoid robotics company Mentee Robotics for approximately $900 million, Mobileye now spans two major tracks of Physical AI, becoming a "dual-engine" company with two main focuses.

On January 26, Alibaba officially launched its flagship reasoning model Qwen3-Max-Thinking, setting several new global records in authoritative evaluations. Its performance rivals that of GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro, making it the strongest domestic AI large model to date, closest to international top-tier models. Through extreme scaling in total parameters, reinforcement learning, and reasoning computation, the new Qwen model achieved a significant leap in performance, breaking global records in key benchmarks such as scientific knowledge (GPQA Diamond), mathematical reasoning (IMO-AnswerBench), and code programming (LiveCodeBench).  

Qwen3-Max-Thinking is currently Alibaba's largest and most capable Qwen reasoning model, with total parameters exceeding one trillion (1T) and pre-training data amounting to 36T tokens. Previously, the preview version of Qwen3-Max-Thinking achieved the first domestic double perfect scores in mathematical reasoning benchmarks AIME 25 and HMMT 25, showcasing impressive reasoning capabilities. Building on this, Alibaba's Tongyi team conducted larger-scale reinforcement learning post-training, comprehensively enhancing the performance of the official Qwen3-Max-Thinking. excerpt_i18n.en:
In 2025, China's smart glasses market is experiencing pre-breakout turbulence. Data from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology shows that shipments in the first three quarters exceeded 1.78 million units, representing a several-fold increase compared to 2024. The annual sales of 2 million units for Meta Ray-Ban's camera glasses validate the market's potential. Companies like Xiaomi and Li Auto have entered the fray, but the industry is mired in a collective dilemma: consumers are forced to choose among audio, camera, and display glasses, with newly purchased devices quickly becoming obsolete due to rapid technological iteration. Manufacturers are obsessed with a lightweight race, yet trapped in the impossible triangle of "lightweight, strong performance, and long battery life." Just as the entire industry is caught in a cycle of "innovation for innovation's sake," Xuanjing unveiled a potential breakthrough at its Tech Open Day. Its M6 series breaks the boundaries of product form with a "magnetic modular" design, redefines user experience logic with "active AI interaction," and challenges the industry's decade-old iron law of iteration with the concept of "buy once, upgrade forever."

Modularity Rewrites Iteration Rules
"What users want is not three functionally fragmented glasses, but a solution that can be combined as needed and freely upgraded," said Xie Xin, Vice President of Xuanjing, capturing the original intent of modular design. In April 2025, Xuanjing launched the ultra-lightweight M5 clip-on AR glasses weighing 25.8 grams. Its "zero-barrier" design, compatible with prescription glasses, topped three major JD.com charts within four hours of launch, reinforcing the team's commitment to modularity.
excerpt_i18n.es: En 2025, el mercado chino de gafas inteligentes experimenta una agitación previa a su explosión: datos del Ministerio de Industria y Tecnología de la Información muestran que en los primeros tres trimestres, las ventas superaron los 1,78 millones de unidades, multiplicándose varias veces en comparación con 2024. Las gafas con cámara Meta Ray-Ban, con ventas anuales de 2 millones de unidades, confirman el potencial del mercado. Fabricantes como Xiaomi y Li Auto se han sumado al sector, pero la industria enfrenta un dilema colectivo: los consumidores se ven obligados a elegir entre gafas de audio, de cámara o con pantalla, y los dispositivos recién adquiridos pronto quedan obsoletos por la rápida evolución tecnológica, convirtiéndose en "chatarra electrónica". Los fabricantes, obsesionados con la competencia por la ligereza, caen en el trilema imposible de "ligereza, alto rendimiento y larga duración de la batería". Mientras toda la industria se debate en la "innovación por innovar".

Previously, the industry focused more on model performance in standardized problems, knowledge Q&A, and literature summarization, but these capabilities essentially remain information processing—they can enhance efficiency but hardly change the fundamental way research progresses. The core challenge in real-world research lies not in isolated capabilities but in the inherently long-chain, uncertain, and validation-dependent closed-loop nature of the research process. A seemingly simple physics problem often requires a full workflow: modeling choices, derivation paths, numerical experiment design, code implementation, parameter tuning and debugging, benchmarking against reference results, and error source analysis. Any misstep can invalidate the conclusion. excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando las capacidades de los grandes modelos evolucionan de responder preguntas a completar tareas, la IA para la Ciencia también está experimentando una transformación más profunda. Anteriormente, la industria se centraba más en el rendimiento de los modelos en preguntas estándar, respuestas de conocimiento y resúmenes de literatura, pero estas habilidades pertenecen esencialmente al procesamiento de información; pueden mejorar la eficiencia, pero difícilmente cambian verdaderamente la forma en que avanza la investigación científica. La dificultad central de la investigación real no radica en si una habilidad puntual es fuerte, sino en que el proceso de investigación es inherentemente un sistema cerrado de cadena larga, incierto y fuertemente dependiente de la verificación. Un problema físico aparentemente simple a menudo requiere pasar por la selección de modelos, la ruta de derivación, el diseño de experimentos numéricos, la implementación de código, el ajuste de parámetros y la depuración de errores, y la comparación.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 作者 | 赵之齐 编辑 | 包永刚 北京一月的初雪落下前，我们在清华见到了翟季冬教授。他手持保温杯，说话很利落，即便一边思考一边叙述，言辞间也几乎没有停顿、没有模糊地带。 这位曾带队拿下15次世界超算冠军的清华计算机系长聘教授，此刻正在拆解一个行业怪象： 为什么在大模型参数狂飙、算力价格下探的当下，用户的AI落地负担却越来越重？ 他指出，如今Benchmark（基准测试）上的高分，在比对用户真实需求时不一定管用，有时，同个模型在不同MaaS平台上跑出来的效果可能差异巨大，因为部分服务商为了降低成本，会对模型进行“阉割级”量化。而面对眼花缭乱的MaaS供应商，用户要在性能、价格与稳定性之间做取舍，往往光调研一轮市场报价，就已耗尽精力。 “把选型的主动权完全交给用户，其实是很大的挑战” ， 翟季冬直言。这种“选择悖论”不仅折磨着开发者，更在吞噬企业的利润——对于企业来说， 降本增效的核心可能并非追求最顶尖的模型，而是如何调度能力恰当的模型，让昂贵的大模型处理复杂指令，让轻量的小模型应付日常任务。 洞察到这一痛点后，由翟季冬的几位毕业学生发起的AI Infra厂商——清程极智，开发出智能路由产品AI Ping（AI 评），希望成为算力界的“大众点评”。 他们将分散的性能数据系统性整理，并收集用户的使用习惯，公开不同模型与供应商的测评数据，并给用户推荐合适的、高性价比方案。翟季冬认为，这种产品形态， 有助于撬动算力行业的马太效应——他相信，当数据越集中，模型的选择就越精准；选择越精准，用户需要付出的成本就越低。 翟季冬 与我们交流时，尽管判断明确，翟季冬说话时的语气却始终都是温和的。他走进会议室时，手上拎着提前为我们备好的饮用水；对话结束后，还为北京凛冽的寒潮给我们来访带来的困扰而“致歉”。待人的认真，也换来了学生们的真心相待——在许多博士生习惯将导师称为“老板”的当下，他的博士生
excerpt_i18n.en:
Author | Zhao Zhiqi  Editor | Bao Yonggang  
Before the first snow of January fell in Beijing, we met Professor Zhai Jidong at Tsinghua University. Holding a thermal cup, he spoke briskly, with almost no pauses or ambiguities even while thinking and narrating simultaneously.  
This tenured professor from Tsinghua’s Department of Computer Science, who has led his team to win 15 world supercomputing championships, was dissecting an industry anomaly:  
Why, amid the soaring parameters of large models and the declining cost of computing power, are users’ burdens for AI implementation growing heavier?  
He pointed out that high scores on benchmarks may not always align with users’ actual needs. Sometimes, the same model can perform vastly differently across various MaaS platforms, as some providers apply “castration-level” quantization to reduce costs. Faced with a dizzying array of MaaS suppliers, users must weigh performance, price, and stability, often exhausting their energy just by surveying market quotes.  
“Leaving the initiative of model selection entirely to users is actually a significant challenge,” Zhai Jidong stated frankly. This “paradox of choice” not only torments developers but also erodes corporate profits. For enterprises, the core of cost reduction and efficiency improvement may not lie in pursuing the most cutting-edge models, but in how to deploy appropriately capable models—using expensive large models for complex instructions and lightweight small models for routine tasks.  
Recognizing this pain point, Qingcheng Jizhi, an AI infrastructure startup founded by several of Zhai Jidong’s former students, developed an intelligent routing system.

Este profesor titular del Departamento de Computación de Tsinghua, que ha liderado al equipo para ganar 15 campeonatos mundiales de supercomputación, estaba desentrañando una peculiaridad de la industria: ¿Por qué, en un momento en que los parámetros de los grandes modelos se disparan y los precios de la potencia de cálculo bajan, la carga de implementación de IA para los usuarios es cada vez mayor?
